== Summary ==
[[Mark Walseth]] with his State Team Tournament medals. He posted it on 26 January 2015 in his announcement of the [[2015 Minnesota State Team Tournament]], attachment name "2 Time Champion", with the note: "Do you think if I make my 3rd medal blue it will clash with the gold one?" The face matches [[:File:Mark Walseth 2017 Hall of Fame.jpg]].

* '''Event:''' [[2015 Minnesota State Team Tournament]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2015-01-26
* '''People:''' [[Mark Walseth]]
